description: Set well back from Golf Links Road on nearly an acre of land, this rare property offers exceptional privacy and opportunity. The approximately 1,700-square-foot home features two bedrooms and two bathrooms and is ready for its next chapter. Surrounded by mature trees, with an arroyo meandering through the property, the setting feels peaceful and secluded while remaining convenient to Oakland amenities. Bring your vision to this rare property and create something truly special on nearly an acre of land. Properties offering this combination of size, setting, and potential are seldom available. "
